question: Two magnetic materials are tested for making an electromagnet. Material A retains strong magnetism even after the current is switched off, while material B becomes strongly magnetised during current flow but loses most of its magnetism when current is removed. Which material should be used for the core of an electromagnet? Give reason.

options.A: Material A, because high retentivity makes the core strongly magnetic.
options.B: Material B, because it has high permeability and low retentivity.
options.C: Material A, because it has low retentivity and high permeability.
options.D: Material B, because it retains strong magnetism after the current is removed.
